chapter: 營業規章 第二章 申請用電 (植根法律網 transcription of 111/9/7)
source: docs/references/secondary/營業規章第二章_植根法律網_1110907.txt

clauses.summary: 第二章 申請用電 第一節 通則

clauses.reason: the kinds of application for supply
a rule on applying for supply, not on the bill's amount
when Taipower may defer a new supply
an existing customer may keep an old 電價種類 until it applies for a change; the caller picks the plan id
the papers needed in a dispute

clauses.summary: 供電契約以本規章與電價表、線路設置費收費費率表為內容，修正公告後適用原已供電之用戶
clauses.reason: the supply contract is the 電價表 and these rules, as amended; the library has no customer start date, so every bill uses the prices in force on its dates (營業規章施行細則 第三十六條)

clauses.summary: 第四節 契約容量之決定
裝置契約容量依用電器具總入力千伏安數訂定，尾數不及一千伏安進整，每一千伏安視為一瓩
clauses.reason: how Taipower sets a 裝置契約容量 from the appliances, rounding up to whole kVA and counting each as a kW; the library takes the contract kW as an input

clauses.summary: 需量契約容量以雙方約定最高需量（十五分鐘平均）為契約容量

clauses.reason: which premises are one customer (設戶); the caller bills each meter
